_note: FL32 preset decisions. Read by fl32_build.mjs. itemEvents: key items given/removed per milestone, in code order (ids hex; sources: FL40 registry _stateGates.items). Slots are simulated by the builder (GiveItemToPlayer fills the first empty slot of $0AB4-$0AC3). Everything is INFERRED until FR40/FR50.

presets.name: new_game_start
presets.expect: Flag $10 clear: sc08_priest locks the joypad at spawn, the lesson text runs, the actor sets $10 and releases the lock. Inventory empty, Will form.

presets.name: after_castle_letter
presets.expect: Flag $3F set: ec0A_left_guard does not lock the joypad at spawn (joypadMaskStd $065A stays 0) and offers the second-floor talk.

presets.name: before_incan_ruins
presets.expect: ir1C_lily locks the joypad at spawn while the entrance flag is clear, the catch-up text runs and control returns. Incan Statue A and B are in the inventory.

presets.name: before_castoth
presets.expect: Flag $0500 clear: the Castoth actor locks the joypad, runs the intro and starts the fight; the player is changed to Shadow if not already (Transform_WillToShadow).

presets.name: before_diamond_mine
presets.expect: dm3E_intro locks the joypad, prints the mine narration, sets its latch flag and unlocks.

presets.name: before_sky_garden
presets.expect: Scene $58 plays its descent cutscene (locks the joypad at spawn, releases it when the script ends); afterwards the player is free.

presets.name: before_viper
presets.expect: Flag $0501 clear: the Viper actor locks the joypad at its intro and starts the fight.

presets.name: before_seaside_palace
presets.expect: The palace monologue actor locks the joypad at spawn and releases it in the same pass when its latch flag is set.

presets.name: before_mu
presets.expect: Scene $60 arrives free: no placed actor of the scene writes the joypad lock.

presets.name: before_vampires
presets.expect: Flag $0502 clear: Erik's cry locks the joypad, the vampires' script releases it and the fight starts.

presets.name: before_great_wall
presets.expect: gw82_trail_intro locks the joypad at spawn on the first visit, sets its latch flag and releases it.

presets.name: before_sand_fanger
presets.expect: Flag $0503 clear: the Sand Fanger actor locks the joypad at its intro and starts the fight.

presets.name: before_mt_kress
presets.expect: mtA0_intro locks the joypad on the first visit and sets its latch flag.

presets.name: before_angkor_wat
presets.expect: awB0_intro locks the joypad on the first visit and sets its latch flag.

presets.name: before_pyramid
presets.expect: Scene $CD arrives free: no placed actor of the scene writes the joypad lock.

presets.name: before_mummy_queen
presets.expect: Flag $0504 clear: the Mummy Queen actor locks the joypad at its intro and starts the fight.

presets.name: before_babel_tower
presets.expect: btDE_monologue locks the joypad on the first visit and sets its latch flag.

presets.name: before_final_area
presets.expect: The space flight controller locks the player through playerFlags $0800 at spawn with no flag test; control returns when the flight ends.

presets.name: before_dark_gaia
presets.expect: Dark Gaia's lair intro locks the player (playerFlags $0800 and the joypad) at spawn and starts the fight; flag $DB clear.
